entry.title: Press statements following Russian-Bruneian talks
entry.content:
Fixture text. We discussed trade and energy cooperation between Russia and Brunei.

Our countries do not seek confrontation with anyone.

entry.title: Meeting with Security Council permanent members
entry.content: Fixture text. The discussion focused on the situation in Ukraine. Reports of Russian drones over Poland are baseless and fabricated, the meeting heard. Russia's exercises near the border are purely defensive.

entry.title: Telephone conversation with President of Turkey
entry.content: Fixture text. The leaders discussed a possible ceasefire on energy infrastructure and the Black Sea.

entry.title: Statement on strikes on Russian territory
entry.content: Fixture text. The Kiev regime's attacks on civilian infrastructure will be met with a mirror response.
